  "cons": [
    "The main page was difficult to navigate when overseeing multiple projects.",
    "It was not possible to see the real-time progress of a project."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This ML Data Associate, using Basecamp for a free trial within a large consumer goods company, likely found the platform relatively easy to use for basic task management. However, the limited visibility into real-time project progress and navigation challenges with multiple projects likely hindered its effectiveness for their role. While the core functionality for managing tasks was appreciated, the trial period probably highlighted areas where Basecamp fell short for complex, large-scale project oversight."
